post.description: Asynchronous: returns 202 immediately with the RFQ `id` (an opportunity id), then prices in the background. Poll `GET /api/v1/rfqs/{id}` until `pricing_status` is `priced` (or `failed`). The `Idempotency-Key` header is REQUIRED — re-sending the same key with the same body returns the original RFQ instead of creating a duplicate; the same key with a different body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. Use the bare alloy code (e.g. `6061`) with the temper in its own field; both must be listed in `GET /api/v1/materials` for that line's form (plate or bar), else 400. Dimensions are INCHES. For a single line, `POST /api/v1/rfqs/item` takes the same fields unwrapped.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (max 200 chars). Re-sending the same key with the same body replays the original RFQ (no duplicate); a different body gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

400.description: Validation failed (missing Idempotency-Key, invalid line shape, an alloy/temper not in GET /api/v1/materials for that form, or bad body).

409.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: this Idempotency-Key was already used for a different RFQ body.

Poll until `pricing_status` leaves `pricing`.

post.description: Converts an already-priced RFQ into an order. `payment: "terms"` creates the PO immediately on the account's payment terms (invoiced later) and returns the PO/SO number. `payment: "card"` returns a `payment_url` the customer opens to pay by card. Every line must be priced; unpriced (e.g. non-plate) lines are rejected with 422 `not_priced`, and an RFQ still pricing is rejected with 409 `pricing_in_progress`. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (recommended) to make retries safe: replaying the same key returns the original response instead of purchasing twice. The cut sheet is still produced by a Nox rep.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: RFQ id (the opportunity id from POST /api/v1/rfqs).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (max 200 chars), strongly recommended. Re-sending the same key replays the original purchase response; a concurrent duplicate gets 409 `purchase_in_progress`; reusing a key for a different RFQ or payment mode gets 409 `idempotency_key_reused`.

404.description: No RFQ with that id is owned by this account.

409.description: Conflict — `pricing_in_progress` (poll until priced, then retry), `purchase_in_progress` (original idempotent request still running), `idempotency_key_reused` (same key, different RFQ/payment), `already_on_card` / `already_on_terms` (a purchase already exists in the other payment mode), `quote_expired` (past `quote_expires_at`; submit a new RFQ).

422.description: `not_priced` — the RFQ has unpriced lines (or pricing failed) and cannot be purchased.

post.summary: Purchase a priced RFQ — place it on terms (PO) or pay by card

post.description: Returns the fulfillment options a purchase would settle at: pickup (always) and, when an `address` is supplied, a rated ship option — each with freight, tax (account exemptions honored), and the landed total. Rates come from the same functions checkout charges with, so the previewed number is the charged number. A lane no carrier can rate returns tier `custom_quote` with `shipping_cost: null` (sales confirms after purchase). Read-only: nothing is created or reserved, and rates are not locked — re-preview shortly before purchasing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: RFQ id (the opportunity id from POST /api/v1/rfqs).

404.description: No RFQ with that id is owned by this account.

422.description: `not_priced` — the RFQ has unpriced lines and cannot be checked out yet.

post.summary: Preview the landed cost of a priced RFQ before purchasing

post.description: Events are POSTed as JSON with headers `x-nox-event`, `x-nox-delivery-id`, and `x-nox-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` where v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "t.body"). The signing `secret` is returned ONLY here — store it. The URL must be public HTTPS (hostnames resolving to private address space are rejected) and unique among the account's active endpoints. Respond 2xx within 10s — redirects are not followed; failures retry with backoff (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 6h, 24h) then stop. Delivery is at-least-once — dedupe on x-nox-delivery-id. Endpoints receive events for every RFQ on the account, regardless of which key created them.

404.description: No active endpoint with that id on this account.

delete.summary: Revoke a webhook endpoint (pending deliveries to it are dropped)

info.title: Nox Metals Public API
info.description: External API for Nox Metals customers — orders and RFQs.

width.description: Inches. Plate, Square Bar, Rectangle Bar and Rectangle Tube width.

height.description: Inches. Rectangle Bar and Rectangle Tube height.

description.description: Human-readable size for the line shape, e.g. 5.118" dia × 7.087" long. Use `dimensions` for exact values.

shape.description: Product form, e.g. Plate | Round Bar | Round Tube

dimensions.description: The line size in inches, using the same field names as the request for this shape (e.g. Round Bar: diameter + length; Round Tube: outer_diameter + wall_thickness + length). Only the fields for the line shape are present.

status.description:
Coarse order status, derived from the internal fulfillment stage:
• `processing` — order placed and being sourced/scheduled (PO received → procurement → scheduling).
• `converted` — in production (material is being cut/fabricated).
• `completed` — production finished, ready to ship.
• `shipped` — shipped or closed.
For finer-grained fulfillment, read `tracking.current_stage` (order_received → material_sourcing → in_production → ready_to_ship → shipped).

customer_po.description: Your PO number: the `po_number` sent on purchase, or the one recorded with Nox for other orders.

tempers.description: Valid temper values — put one in the `temper` field.

ref.description: Caller line ref, for API-submitted RFQs

shape.description: Product form, e.g. Plate | Round Bar | Round Tube | Square Tube

description.description: Human-readable size for the line shape, e.g. 5.118" dia × 7.087" long. Use `dimensions` for exact values.

dimensions.description: The line size in inches, using the same field names as the request for this shape (e.g. Round Bar: diameter + length; Round Tube: outer_diameter + wall_thickness + length). Only the fields for the line shape are present.

height.description: Wall (tubes) / secondary cross-section dimension, in inches; null for plate and bar

availability.description: `available` when the line is priced and can be ordered (delivery per `lead_time`), `unavailable` when it could not be priced. Null until pricing has assessed the line. Detail only.

certifications.description: Required material certifications recorded on the line, as submitted (detail only).

status.description: Customer-facing funnel status, e.g. draft | sent | accepted

pricing_status.description: Async pricing-job status for API-submitted RFQs; null otherwise

pricing_source.description: How a priced RFQ was priced: `wayne` (optimized nest solve) or `availability_fallback` (conservative stock-availability price, used when the solver is unavailable — the same fallback the website quote shows). Null while pricing or for non-API RFQs.

converted_so_number.description: SO number once the RFQ converts to an order

quote_expires_at.description: When the quoted price stops being honored (ISO 8601; null when it cannot be derived). A stamped expiry wins; otherwise the quote validity window set by Nox runs from when the quote was sent, else created. Re-poll for the current value while the quote is being worked. After this time POST /purchase is refused with 409 `quote_expired`; submit a new RFQ for fresh pricing.

alloy.description: Bare alloy code only — e.g. "6061". Do NOT append the temper (no "6061-T651"); put the temper in the `temper` field.

shape.description: With `product_type`: a cross-section (Plate, Round, Square, Rectangle). Without it: a combined value (Plate, Round Bar, …). Default "Plate". Case-insensitive.

temper.description: Temper, separate from the alloy code — e.g. "T651".

thickness.description: Inches. Required with width + length for Plate.

job_detail.description: Per-line job detail / note (stored on the line)

certifications.description: Required material certifications for this line (max 10) — same shape as the website quote form. Recorded on the line, shown to sales/production, and verified against mill certs before material release. Stock availability does not constrain on them.

customer.description: Optional end-customer details; defaults are pulled from the account behind the key

bill_to_address.description: Override bill-to address (else the account HQ address)

ship_to_address.description: Override ship-to address (else the account default address)

alloy.description: Bare alloy code only — e.g. "6061". Do NOT append the temper (no "6061-T651"); put the temper in the `temper` field.

shape.description: With `product_type`: a cross-section (Plate, Round, Square, Rectangle). Without it: a combined value (Plate, Round Bar, …). Default "Plate". Case-insensitive.

temper.description: Temper, separate from the alloy code — e.g. "T651".

thickness.description: Inches. Required with width + length for Plate.

job_detail.description: Per-line job detail / note (stored on the line)

certifications.description: Required material certifications for this line (max 10) — same shape as the website quote form. Recorded on the line, shown to sales/production, and verified against mill certs before material release. Stock availability does not constrain on them.

customer.description: Optional end-customer details; defaults are pulled from the account behind the key

bill_to_address.description: Override bill-to address (else the account HQ address)

ship_to_address.description: Override ship-to address (else the account default address)

state.description: Card-checkout state for this RFQ. `awaiting_payment`: a live payment session exists — the customer completes payment_url (a declined card stays retryable here). `paid`: payment settled — the order exists, fetch GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}; later refunds/disputes do not change this state (they belong to the order). `expired`: no payable session remains (canceled, or the session was never created); POST /purchase again — it safely reuses or re-mints the checkout while the quote is still valid (see quote_expires_at).

payment_url.description: Browser URL to complete payment (awaiting_payment only)

order_id.description: Order id once paid — poll GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}

expires_at.description: When the open checkout stops being payable (awaiting_payment only)

status.description: Customer-facing funnel status, e.g. draft | sent | accepted

pricing_status.description: Async pricing-job status for API-submitted RFQs; null otherwise

pricing_source.description: How a priced RFQ was priced: `wayne` (optimized nest solve) or `availability_fallback` (conservative stock-availability price, used when the solver is unavailable — the same fallback the website quote shows). Null while pricing or for non-API RFQs.

converted_so_number.description: SO number once the RFQ converts to an order

quote_expires_at.description: When the quoted price stops being honored (ISO 8601; null when it cannot be derived). A stamped expiry wins; otherwise the quote validity window set by Nox runs from when the quote was sent, else created. Re-poll for the current value while the quote is being worked. After this time POST /purchase is refused with 409 `quote_expired`; submit a new RFQ for fresh pricing.

checkout.description: Present when a card purchase was started for this RFQ; null otherwise. After payment settles the RFQ stays fetchable BY ID with status "converted" and checkout.state "paid" (it no longer 404s); like terms conversions it leaves the GET /api/v1/rfqs funnel list — the order appears in GET /api/v1/orders.

payment.description: `terms` places the order on the account's payment terms (PO created immediately, invoiced later). `card` returns a payment_url the customer opens to pay.

delivery_date.description: Requested delivery date (YYYY-MM-DD). Advisory — the binding promise derives from production lead time + transit, exactly like a website order.

contact.description: Card: buyer contact. Defaults to the RFQ/account contact if omitted.

address.description: Card: ship-to address. Required for card + fulfillment "ship" (freight is quoted via Echo).

opportunity_id.description: Opportunity id the order was created from.

payment_url.description: Browser URL for the customer to complete card payment (card).

replayed.description: True when this is the stored response of a previous request with the same Idempotency-Key.

address.description: Ship-to address. When present the response includes a rated "ship" option; pickup is always included.

contact_email.description: Buyer email used for tax-exemption lookup — pass the SAME email you will send as `contact.email` on the purchase, or the previewed tax may differ from the charged tax. Defaults to the RFQ contact.

reason.description: Why the tax is what it is

tier.description: Shipping tier, e.g. will_call | ups_ground | ltl_class70 | custom_quote

shipping_cost.description: Freight in USD. Null on tier custom_quote — no carrier could rate the lane; sales confirms the freight after purchase.

total.description: Landed total (subtotal + freight + tax). Null when freight is unquoted.

subtotal.description: Sum of priced line totals, USD

frozen.description: True when a card checkout is already open for this RFQ: the returned single option is the FROZEN price/freight that checkout will actually charge (its fulfillment mode is pinned), not a live re-rate.

quoted_at.description: When these rates were computed. Carrier rates move; preview shortly before purchasing.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives event POSTs.

events.description: Events to subscribe to. `rfq.priced` fires when async pricing completes; `rfq.pricing_failed` when it fails.

secret.description: Signing secret — returned ONLY on creation, store it then. Verify x-nox-signature with it.
